description: An object type, string and the dynamic pseudo-type unify to the dynamic pseudo-type
notes: Converting to map(any) unifies the attribute types. The spec says the dynamic pseudo-type is the result of unification only if all the types are the dynamic pseudo-type, and has no rule unifying an object type with string, so these attribute types have no common type; it lets a null convert to a null of any type, but doesn't say which map type that would be here. go-cty's unify (cty/convert/unify.go) finds no rule for the mixture, tries each given type in turn, and accepts the dynamic pseudo-type, to which everything converts, so conversionObjectToMap in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go finds a conversion, and getConversion in cty/convert/conversion.go turns the null object into a null map of the dynamic pseudo-type (dynamicReplace in cty/convert/conversion_dynamic.go). A known object with these attributes fails to convert instead.
